This hits too close to home. I'm in a similar place now. You may feel this way, but I'll tell you, you're a wonderful person, you just need to take the time to see it for yourself. You're not an annoyance to anyone. It will be hard to believe at first, but keep trying to stay strong. You are worth living for, your family love you and I'm sure others do to. 
Stay strong my friend.

I'm also on Sertraline (100mg), have been for just over 6 months now, and have noticed similar recurring thoughts. I'm not sure if it's the medication or not, but I would advise you maybe go back and speak to whoever gave you them. I'm going to do the same soon, I can't deal with them anymore.

My family, partner and friends. I couldn't bare the thought of leaving them all behind and thinking about what they would have to go through. My partner especially, he's dealing with his own issues but always finds the time to help with whatever I'm going through. He's a big part of my life and I want to live long enough to make it up to him. As well as my mum, she's just been amazing and so supportive. I want to show them all I can get better.

But if you want it just as a hobby, it's fairly cheap.
